text:
Maya (AE): Prospect needs SOC2 control excerpt + signed pen-test letter and a secure way to drop redacted logs. They asked for an SFTP endpoint into a staging network. Deadline: next Wed COB.

Omar (Solutions): We can offer presigned S3 by default. If they insist on SFTP we use an SFTP->S3 gateway with IP allowlist and per-tenant bucket. Both support 7d retention.

Lena (Security): Requirements: remove PII (mask emails/IPs), strip auth tokens, provide sha256 manifest, and a customer attestation of redaction. Pen-test letter: date + firm + high-level scope only.

Ravi (RevOps): Price note: short POC reserved capacity + secure ingestion = +$2k. SFTP gateway add-on = +$450. Presigned links save about $300. Draft quote in internal pricing.

Kira (Legal): We'll send a short NDA before handing over SOC-related artifacts. I can pre-sign a one-paragraph pen-test attestation for our side.

ingest-bot: Created bucket poc-2976543210 with lifecycle 7 days; quarantine prefix /incoming/.

Maya (AE): Action items: Omar to confirm upload method (target today), Lena to post redaction checklist, Ravi to attach quote, Kira to prep NDA and attestation. I'll get CIDR and upload window from customer.
